description: As the newly appointed VP of Sales at a financial services technology firm, the board has flagged serious data quality issues in the CRM pipeline ahead of next week's investor presentation. Multiple opportunities contain internally contradictory data: deals still sitting in active stages despite close dates that passed months ago, probability percentages that bear no relationship to their current sales stage, and at least one deal marked as Closed Won with a close date in the future. Review every opportunity in SuiteCRM and bring each record into compliance. Stale deals whose close dates are more than 60 days in the past and are still in active stages should be moved to Closed Lost with 0% probability. Each opportunity's probability must accurately reflect its sales stage according to standard CRM conventions. Closed Won deals must have close dates in the past. Do not alter opportunities whose data is already internally consistent.
